attributes.name: The Pirate Council
attributes.powers:
If undefeated, you may banish 1 plunder card per character to defeat the Pirate Council.

"Lots of liars say they know someone on the council, or they say they're a step from being on it themselves, or they're the newest member. If you're good enough to stand toe-to-toe with the Hurricane King and go diving off the nearest pier, then you're not someone who needs to tell drunks you're tough."—Iolik Vok, former cabin boy aboard the Filthy Lucre
